name: small_sims_and_neighbors_overrides
description: Caller overrides simulation_paths and neighbor_k away from defaults. Ensures the parameter wiring works regardless of how defaults are named after extraction (MC_DEFAULT_SIMULATION_PATHS / MC_DEFAULT_NEIGHBOR_K). Uses numpy seed 123 to demonstrate determinism under a different seed.
derivation: Captured behavioral pin under numpy.random.seed(123). Exercises non-default parameters: simulation_paths=100, neighbor_k=10. Under these parameters and seed, the resulting sim distribution places current_symphony_return at or below the smallest value (below_count=0 from searchsorted 'left' semantics on a value <= all sorted entries), yielding (100-0)/100*100=100.0. Pin protects against any default-value extraction altering parameter wiring.
